name: Buddy
subtitle: Buddy, your AI helper in the Dynamic Island

apps.name: Buddy
apps.subtitle: Ask anything from the Dynamic Island
apps.localizedDescription: Buddy lives in your Dynamic Island. Tap it to ask, or double-tap the back of your iPhone to send a screenshot - the answer appears right in the island while you stay in your app. Free brain, no account.

versions.localizedDescription:
• Windows
• A press without the mouse in an app you had open already. While a followed task has a program at work that presses through Windows (it has UI Automation loaded and shows no window: any program of an AI agent; of a scheduled task a script), the other windows on screen are listened to as well, up to 20. A press, tick, list entry or filled box there is taken for that task, and the trace says (not its own window: taken for its click). Nothing is taken while your own hand was at the keys or the mouse in the last 5 seconds.
• Typing a program does with the keyboard, in every window, also in a command window, in Firefox and in a program that draws everything itself. Windows marks a key a program made. The trace never has which keys. A key within 1 second of your own key or click is left out (a helper that completes what you type).
• A box that is filled in without the keyboard, and round option boxes in Windows Forms and WPF programs.
• A real window that PowerShell or Python shows (a form, a small tool) is followed like any other. Only the black command window itself is not.
• What stays out, because Windows does not tell it: a press without the mouse in an app that is not the task's own while you are at the keys or the mouse yourself. A program that only sends window messages and never loads UI Automation. A program that has a window of its own and presses other apps from there. A scheduled task's compiled program without a window (only scripts count). The very first press of a script started a blink ago. What a program writes into a command window without the keyboard. In a program that draws everything itself only mouse clicks and keyboard typing are shown. Firefox is not on the PC this was built on: presses without the mouse were not measured there, so nothing was built for it. And in a window that is not the task's own Windows never says who did it: an app that changes something by itself while your hands are off can be taken for the task. The trace always says taken for.
• Mac (Buddy Lite)
• A program's typing gets the agent pointer (osascript is typing here), only if Buddy is ticked under System Settings > Privacy & Security > Accessibility. macOS lets no app hear keys without that. Buddy never asks for it by itself; the menu has a line that says whether it is on.

privacy.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Buddy looks at your latest screenshot only when you ask about it.
